artworks.title: From Pickle-Herring Stairs
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with boats in a river or harbor. Some boats are close to us, while others stretch into the distance. The buildings and masts create a horizon line blending into the sky. Linear brushstrokes give an impressionistic effect. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. A rowing boat is visible close to us on the left. In the distance, larger vessels with tall masts cluster together. Buildings rise above the water in the background.

artworks.title: A Sketch from Billingsgate
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene with various ships and boats on the water. The perspective is from slightly above, showing the water filled with vessels. Tall masts of sailboats obscure most of the horizon. The sketch-like style is characterized by soft etching, creating a sense of detail through overlapping lines. The color scheme is monochrome, with varying shades of gray to black on an off-white background. Larger boats are in the foreground, leading the eye towards smaller vessels in the distance. Industrial structures are visible along the shoreline in the background.

artworks.title: A Sketch from Billingsgate
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows boats and ships docked at a harbor. The viewpoint is from the water's edge, angled to display the masts and sails of the boats vertically. The horizon is not visible, with ships and buildings extending across the middle to upper third of the image. Delicate and precise brushstrokes capture the details of the ships. The palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray against a light cream background. Skiffs and rowboats are closest to us, sketched in thin lines, with larger sailing vessels and city structures in the distance. The style resembles a classic etching technique, creating a detailed maritime view with fine lines.

artworks.title: Whistler with the White Lock
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on light grey laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait sketch of a person's upper torso and head. The person is sitting in a slightly turned position, facing towards the left side of the frame. The sketch features soft, unfinished details of the facial features, highlighting a mustache and an ambiguous expression. The person's hair is depicted as loose curls around the head. The clothing is suggested with minimal and lightly drawn lines, possibly indicating a collared garment like a jacket. The background consists of crosshatched lines, creating a textured appearance, while the rest of the space is left blank to draw focus to the subject.

artworks.title: Whistler with the White Lock
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on pale green laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows thick, overlapping diagonal lines forming a loose grid pattern. Varying intensity of shadow and texture creates an abstract composition, resembling a net or web. Subtle smudges and etchings at the intersections suggest a concealed object, possibly a face or natural formation. The overall arrangement evokes mystery and a sense of peering through a latticework.

artworks.title: The Large Pool
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with small boats on the shore and larger sailing ships anchored in the water. In the background, there are structures indicating a port town. The sketch is done in sepia tones, with fine lines and detailed work creating a sense of realism.

artworks.title: The 'Adam and Eve', Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on  Asian wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside dock with boats docked along the edge. Buildings line the waterfront with signs such as "Johnson Coal Merchant" and "The Adam and Eve." A figure walks on a pathway, adding scale to the scene. The etching features fine lines for detail and texture, with a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: The 'Adam and Eve', Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with moored boats and old buildings in the background. The buildings have chimneys and a sign with "THE ADAM and EVE." The details are captured with a fine, etching technique in sepia tones. Boats are docked near the shore, with one floating on the water.

artworks.title: Under Old Battersea Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a viewpoint between two tall structures with a low horizon showing faint shapes resembling boats and small buildings in the distance. The lines and brushstrokes in the piece are minimalistic and precise, with a delicate, sketch-like technique. The color palette is monochromatic, limited to shades of beige and black, providing a muted, soft appearance. The structures in the foreground have stronger lines, while those in the background are lighter and less distinct, giving a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Old Battersea Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge over a river, with figures on the bridge. In the background, there are industrial buildings and rooftops. The water is depicted with gentle ripples, and a sailboat with two sails is visible. The color palette is mainly muted sepia tones.

artworks.title: Old Putney Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a view of a bridge over a calm body of water. The bridge and surrounding trees create a horizontal line across the composition. The artwork features precise and delicate lines, giving it a sketch-like quality. The color palette consists of sepia tones and dark lines, with textured details adding depth. Two figures are seen in a boat, and other boats are visible under the bridge. People can be seen walking along the bridge, adding to the lively yet serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Little Putney, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a sailboat on the water. Trees line the horizon, and there is a building on the right. The artwork uses fine, sketch-like lines and a monochromatic sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Fulham
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river and a bridge stretching across the scene. The bridge has small figures on it and a lattice-like structure supported by pillars. Near the riverbank, there are boats and logs on the water. Trees and possibly buildings are seen on the right side. The background has a clear sky with light clouds, complementing the water's patterns. The etching technique is used for detailed lines. The color scheme is primarily sepia, creating a timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Little Venice
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water in the foreground and a distant horizon with various buildings and towers. Brushstrokes are subtle and delicate, creating fine lines and a minimalist style. The color palette is monochrome sepia, and there are boats and poles in the water. The sky has light, wispy clouds in the distance.

artworks.title: Nocturne
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view across a body of water with tall ships and a distant cityscape. The style features fine etching brushstrokes creating a misty atmosphere and reflections on the water. The color palette includes sepia and muted grays. The water leads the eye towards the cityscape, enhancing the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Nocturne
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a misty seascape. The horizon is low in the composition, with silhouettes of ships with tall masts and a distant cityscape or structures. The style uses soft brushstrokes blurring the lines between water and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia. The water reflects gentle textures with a soft focus.

artworks.title: The Little Mast
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy street scene near a waterfront. People and dogs are visible on the cobblestone street, with ships docked in the distance. The horizon, ships, and buildings are depicted with precise, delicate etching lines. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones. The sky features lightly sketched clouds.

artworks.title: The Little Lagoon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.86 x 15.24 cm (9 x 6 in.)
sheet (with tab): 23.5 × 15.24 cm (9 1/4 × 6 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a distance view overlooking a body of water with small boats. The horizon line is positioned around the upper third of the image, showing a faint outline of land and larger ships in the distance. The delicate style features fine, sketch-like brown lines defining the elements such as boats and ripples on the water. Near us, a couple of slender posts protrude from the water, while a small boat glides by with individuals rowing. In the background, there is a soft transition into land and sky. The color palette is muted and monochromatic, mainly tan and brown tones, creating a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: The Palaces
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and open bite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with buildings on both sides. The perspective is from across the canal, capturing the full view of the buildings. The horizon is obstructed by the buildings along the canal, which are the main focus. The etching technique creates detailed lines, showing architectural features and reflections in the water. The color scheme is sepia, adding a historical quality, with varying tones for depth. Gondolas are seen on the water, with ornate building facades in the background. The sky blends into the background with subtle linework suggesting rooftops and chimneys in the distance.

artworks.title: The Piazzetta
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 25.4 x 17.78 cm (10 x 7 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 25.72 x 17.78 cm (10 1/8 x 7 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an urban square filled with people. The view is slightly elevated, capturing the historic square with various architectural structures. In the center is an ornate building with a clock. The sky is partially filled with some clouds. People are seen on steps in the foreground. The architecture is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating depth. The color scheme is predominantly sepia. In the distance, people are spread out around the square, including street vendors.

artworks.title: The Traghetto, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view of a narrow passageway or courtyard. The scene is enclosed by surrounding architecture and foliage, with no prominent horizon visible. On the left, two people stand close by, and on the right, a group of individuals gathered around a table. The brushwork features delicate, fine lines depicting intricate details and texture in trees and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow for depth. In the distance, the passageway darkens, with a hint of daylight further ahead.

artworks.title: The Riva, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a quay from an elevated perspective. The quay is busy with various boats, including a large sailing ship. The painting features delicate brushstrokes with a subdued color palette dominated by soft sepia tones. Figures are seen walking along the quay and engaging in conversation. City buildings in the distance frame the scene.

artworks.title: Two Doorways
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brownish-black ink on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a Venetian canal scene in an etching style. A large, arched stone doorway and building walls are depicted with intricate lines. The canal leads the eye towards a bridge in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic sepia. Water reflections and a gondola in the canal add detail to the scene. The composition uses light and shadow to highlight architectural details.

artworks.title: Two Doorways
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brownish-black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a narrow canal lined with buildings. The artist uses detailed etching techniques to create texture and depth. The scene is rendered in sepia tones, giving it a vintage quality. The composition includes an archway with a figure, gondolas in the canal, and densely packed buildings in the background.
